name: Akae Tomoka
source:
Nicknamed "Young Lady", she and the protagonist are friends of the same age.
Her family is as famous as the Utsumi family in Tatsumiya Village.
Her grandfather is the village's current mayor and her father is a member of the village council.

Her future dream is to become the first female mayor in the history of Tatsumiya Village
She is a strong and forceful character, but she is surprisingly sensible and compassionate.

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
